deviations_from_card: 1) No `live` field on Layer: `isLive(layer)` is derived from the phase in layers.ts (one source of truth, cannot disagree with phase). 2) The still is captured in SceneLayer's getSnapshotBeforeUpdate (SceneLayer became a class) instead of during Stage's render: reading the DOM ref in render failed the react-hooks/refs lint, and getSnapshotBeforeUpdate is React's own before-mutation hook. 3) still.ts is loaded by import() after the first frame, not statically: static cost +506 B gzipped (over the ceiling by 30 B at HEAD), lazy +245 B. A move before the module lands leaves its layer empty for that leave. 4) stage.css untouched (not needed). 5) SVG elements keep their ids in the still (gradients/masks reference them); HTML ids are stripped.
